drivingQuestion: How long must the knife be for a decapitation in the course of slaughter to remain valid?
outcomeNote: A lemma and a single gloss; the ambiguity in Rabbi Zeira's words is taken up in the next unit.

segments.he: הָיָה שׁוֹחֵט וְהִתִּיז, אָמַר רַבִּי זֵירָא: מְלֹא צַוָּאר וְחוּץ לַצַּוָּאר.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: In a case where «one was» in the process of «slaughtering» the animal in the standard manner «and he decapitated» the animal in one motion, if the length of the knife is equivalent to the breadth of the animal’s entire neck, the slaughter is valid. «Rabbi Zeira says:» The knife must be equivalent to «the» breadth of the animal’s «entire neck and» extend «beyond the neck.»
